notes: Tokenizer checked: Sänger, sputum, Sapporo, Sverdlovsk, Sörenstam, Söhne, Sèvres, Sámi all split off ' S'/' s'; Stuttgart, sabotage, sclerosis, Sinai are one token. Probe: '-S'trauss 0.62, ' S'äfte 0.83, ' s'puttered 0.38, ' sun' 0.005.
